note: Held-out set written apart from the search and its vocabulary (13 Nov 2026). Tests only.

questions.question: Which accounts are evaluating a competitor?
variants: Who is trialling or comparing another analytics vendor?
Where are we in a tender or bake-off against another tool?

questions.question: Which customers are under budget pressure?
variants: Which customers have been told to cut costs or spend less on software?
Where is finance squeezing spend, freezing hiring or reviewing subscriptions?

questions.question: Where is our main contact leaving the company?
variants: Which accounts are about to lose the person who runs Cairnpath for them?
Where has our key sponsor resigned or moved on?

questions.question: Which accounts have data quality problems?
variants: Where are customers saying the numbers look wrong or can't be trusted?
Which accounts have missing, duplicated or broken tracking?

questions.question: Which accounts aren't really using what they bought?
variants: Who has paid for an add-on or rollout that never happened?
Which accounts have far fewer people using it than planned?

questions.question: Which customers need more capacity?
variants: Which accounts are about to run past their yearly event commitment?
Who is growing fast enough to need a bigger contract?

questions.question: Which accounts are disputing an invoice?
variants: Which customers are refusing to pay a charge or asking for a credit?
Where is a bill being contested or held back?

questions.question: Which accounts have open security or compliance requirements?
variants: Which customers are waiting on questionnaires, certificates or data protection answers from us?
Where is a security or legal sign-off blocking a rollout?

questions.question: Which new customers are stuck getting started?
variants: Which recently signed accounts still have no data coming in?
Where is the first implementation blocked or stalled?
